Prevention: Ensure proper land preparation to make sure that your soil is well drained
Provide adequate plant spacing to reduce the density of the canopy and improve aeration.
Thin plants and prune infected shoots also helps improve plant's aeration and reduce disease inoculum.
Plough-under all the plant debris after harvest
Practice crop rotation with non-brassica crops
Alter planting dates to avoid rainy periods so as to avoid high disease pressure period
Monitoring: Scouting should begin when the plants are young until harvest time
Direct Control: Remove infected plants and prune infected leaves/ shoots
Properly dispose of collected diseased-parts either by burning or burying them
Restrictions: U (Unlikely to present acute hazard); Follow
